name: breeches
_design_note: F1-20 light legs slot. Lowest-tier leg covering — quilted hose. Covers cloth_leggings, padded_leggings from legacy data.
lore_template: These quilted {material_name} breeches are cut full at the thigh and narrow at the calf. Their padding turns a glancing edge more often than any would expect, and it keeps the knees whole upon a floor of stone.
